name: Moped
description: A vehicle on two tandem wheels or three, each over 250 mm, with a seat at least 650 mm high and a motor of 50 cc or less, or an electric motor, that can't take it past 70 km/h; an electric two-wheeler in that range is one, and it's a motor vehicle but not a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: Two tandem wheels or three, each more than 250 mm across, and a seat or saddle at least 650 mm high unladen
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1

restrictions.rule: A gas engine of 50 cc or less or an electric motor of any power, either unable to propel it past 70 km/h
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Driven by pedals, motor or both; pedals aren't required
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Not a motorcycle, so the Act's motorcycle helmet, passenger and riding rules don't name it
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, ss. 1 and 242 to 245

restrictions.rule: A motor vehicle: registered and plated, with a motor vehicle liability policy, to be ridden on a highway
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, ss. 1, 5, 6 and 36(2)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a driver's licence; a Class 5 licence, from age 16, covers "a motorcycle known as a moped"
restrictions.citation: Driver's Licence Regulations, R.R.N.W.T. 1990, c. M-27, s. 3(2) and Schedule A
